components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Removes the werewolf side: a werewolf becomes human again, a hybrid or a tribrid a plain vampire. The gene stays.

The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be on the werewolf side. An Original hybrid cannot be cured by it.

A refusal gives the ingredients back.

Needs a full moon: the moon must be full, between dusk and dawn, in the Overworld. An eclipse counts too. The hub's moon calendar shows when the next one rises.

This rite needs the Werewolves mod.
